name: customer-experience
title: Customer Photo Gallery
description: A peach page with a giant orange EXPERIENCE title over a list of photo categories. Each row pairs an arrow and label with a right-aligned description, and hovering any row releases a floating photo that follows the cursor.
use: A photography or portfolio index wants a text list where hovering each entry previews its photo under the cursor.
avoid: The preview needs a mouse, so touch and keyboard users only get the text, and every image URL is fixed.
a11y: Rows are plain divs with mouse-only handlers, so the photo preview cannot be reached by keyboard or touch; no reduced-motion handling. (keyboard: no, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Warm peach background with a very large orange uppercase title above a stack of rows divided by thin orange rules. Each row has a diagonal orange arrow, a bold category name with a small grey subtitle on the left, and a grey paragraph on the right. A rounded photo drifts over the list.
behaves: Moving the pointer onto a row fades in that row's photograph and it springs after the cursor across the page. Leaving the row fades the photo out again, and the list itself never moves.
customise: Eight photo rows with labels, subtitles, paragraphs and image URLs are hardcoded; the peach palette and preview size need source edits.
weight: light: Eight text rows and one spring-following image that idles when the pointer stops.
